source.title: Municipal Statistics Annual Report 2021–2022
source.publisher: Nova Scotia Department of Municipal Affairs and Housing
source.basis: Source-reported consolidated financial information extracted from municipal Financial Information Returns; not independently audited by this application
source.rightsReview: Reviewed projection is limited to numerical facts, public institution labels, source locators and concise independently written context; no report facsimile, logos, personal details or extended narrative. This does not establish a blanket licence or commercial reproduction permission for source material.

limitations: Historical 2021–2022 figures, not current capital-project status. The observed official annual-report listing ended at report 2022; newer municipal indicator pages are a different product.
Capital additions and asset balances are not verified cash payments, vendor awards or delivered projects.
Rows include overlapping totals. Do not sum all rows or all measures. Stocks, additions, disposals and amortization have different meanings.
The table headings do not explicitly state currency or scale. Values remain source numbers with currency and unit multiplier unknown; do not automatically format as dollars.
Table 3.6.2 repeats March 31, 2021 for its second accumulated-amortization column despite the March 31, 2022 table heading. Preserve the printed date; normalized asOf is null, not silently corrected.
Mahone Bay source zeros are reporting-exclusion placeholders, normalized to null while raw zeros remain visible.
No exact-ID linkage to accepted portal municipality abbreviations or other fiscal datasets is asserted.
The contents pages use older year labels; selected table headings and methodology explicitly identify 2021–2022.
